role: Declares the shared structure block layer (structure_blocks.c): the sc_ent and sc_ctx structs, the block-id and entity-kind enums, CART_SLOTS, and every StructureComponent helper plus sc_generate; documents the seam each structure type's <type>_blocks dispatch plugs into.

structs.name: struct sc_ent
structs.java: an entity a structure piece constructed (EntityMinecartChest, EntityItem, EntityVillager, EntityWitch)

structs.name: struct sc_ctx
structs.java: World, step StructureBoundingBox and population Random passed to addComponentParts, plus Det role OTHER and World.rand

structs.name: sc_piece_fn
structs.java: StructureComponent.addComponentParts, as a function pointer per structure type

gpu: line 65, struct sc_ctx: piece_fn is a function pointer and ents a heap array the context grows (pointer state the GPU cannot mirror as is)
line 50, struct sc_ent: slots are loot_stack values whose tag field is heap-owned (see structure_blocks.c sc_ent_free)
notes: Header only; the implementations and their hazards are in structure_blocks.c.
